data.description:
## Description
**What**: Build a multi-language synthetic end-to-end test exercising the nine fixture scenarios from SC5 end to end (both scripts plus the completion-verifier consumption).
**Why**: The unit tests cover each script in isolation; this story proves the integrated path including the verifier rendering, and pins the primary real-world miss pattern (mid-sprint SC addition) as a regression fixture.
**Scope**:
- IN: fixtures and assertions for (a) happy path Python plus bash (zero findings), (b) intent_with_no_test with a non-empty verifier 'Intent Allocation Findings' section, (c) header_source_mismatch for a Python and a bash fixture, (d) source_files_unresolved fail-open skip, (e) file_impact_likely_stale with surviving-entry matching, (f) deferred_test override not blocking closure, (g) missing_sg emitting dynamic_import_inconclusive with no grep fallback and no pre-commit block, (h) backward_compat_94ed_legacy graceful handling; the mid-sprint-SC-addition scenario run in a configuration-isolated environment.
- OUT: per-language dynamic-import pattern detection unit verification (sc-6, covered by draft-5); the scripts and wiring themselves.

## Done Definitions

- The e2e test exercises the happy-path Python and bash fixtures end to end and both scripts return zero findings ← Satisfies: sc-5
- The e2e test exercises the intent_with_no_test, header_source_mismatch, source_files_unresolved, file_impact_likely_stale, deferred_test-override, missing_sg, and backward_compat_94ed_legacy fixtures and each produces its specified finding and severity ← Satisfies: sc-5
- An integration test exercises the mid-sprint-SC-addition path (1 SC and 1 passing test_artifact, then a 2nd SC added with no test_artifact) in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no environment variables pre-set from the developer's machine) and the test passes, surfacing intent_with_no_test and a non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section ← Validates Closure Check: "(i) MID_SPRINT_SC_ADDITION: fixture epic with 1 SC and 1 test_artifact registered passing; a 2nd SC is added to the epic description without registering a corresponding test_artifact. intent-coverage-check.sh surfaces intent_with_no_test for the new SC; completion-verifier dispatch produces non-empty 'Intent Allocation Findings' section. Verifies the primary real-world miss pattern."

## Considerations

- [Build] The e2e test script is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.
- [Reliability] The mid-sprint-SC-addition fixture must isolate HOME and git config so it does not inherit the developer machine's ambient git identity or worktrees, which would mask CI-only failures.
- [Performance] The e2e suite runs the test-pass validation step; keep individual fixture invocations targeted so the suite stays within the bash-tool timeout when run via test-batched.sh.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a nine-scenario multi-language synthetic end-to-end test, so that the full checks-to-verifier path is proven across happy-path and adversarial fixtures.
